test_title: PYST 30: SSC MTS 2024 - Reasoning Ability and Problem Solving (Held On: 22 Oct, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
This question has two statements followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. You have to take the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. You have to decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the given statements.

Statements:

All jugs are taps.

Some taps are hats.

Conclusions:

(I) Some taps are jugs.

(II) All hats are jugs.
solution:
Given Statements:

All jugs are taps.

Some taps are hats.

Venn Diagram:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3b46ec06d1020b1b1bff44a9d41b03d965ea82b548d004b83be527b6ccf2bba8.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fc69a42d4ce2bfbca327e0e4b0d2055d8138b8c8879eb5ac13517c08e944e23d.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some taps are jugs.→ Follows (Since all jugs are inside the taps circle, there is definitely a portion of the taps circle that contains jugs. Therefore, some taps are jugs. This conclusion is true.)

II. All hats are jugs. → Does not follow (The diagram shows that the "Hats" circle only has a partial overlap with the "Taps" circle. There is no indication that all hats are inside the "Jugs" circle. It is possible that some hats are taps but not jugs, or even completely outside the "Jugs" circle. Therefore, we cannot conclude that all hats are jugs. This conclusion is false.)

So, the only conclusion I follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**
